hooks.name: Regenerate proof report when decisions.yaml changes
hooks.description: Regenerates the proof report for a migration when its decisions.yaml is saved.

action.command: python3 -c "import sys,re,subprocess; d=sys.stdin.read(); m=re.search(r'(\.kiro/specs/[^/\"]+)/decisions\.yaml', d); sys.exit(0) if not m else sys.exit(subprocess.call(['python3','-m','ghost.cli','report',m.group(1)]))"
